not_in_report.question: What is the company's current share price today?
not_in_report.answer: The report does not give a current share price. It gives an aggregate market value of non-affiliate common stock of $3.6 trillion as of December 31, 2025 (cover page) and average repurchase prices for April to June 2026 (Item 5, p.32). These are historical and are not a current price.
not_in_report.source: Cover page; Item 5, Share Repurchases table, p.32

not_in_report.question: What is the company's own earnings guidance for the next fiscal year?
not_in_report.answer: The report gives no numerical earnings guidance for FY2027. It states qualitatively that the company will keep investing in AI and cloud infrastructure, which will increase operating costs and may reduce operating margins (MD&A, p.35). It also notes that about 30% of remaining performance obligations are expected to be recognized in the next 12 months (Note 12, p.75).
not_in_report.source: Item 7 MD&A, Economic Conditions, p.35; Note 12 Unearned Revenue, p.75

not_in_report.question: What is an analyst's estimate of the company's fair value?
not_in_report.answer: The report contains no analyst fair-value estimate. Management's discussion of goodwill impairment uses internal discounted cash flow assumptions but gives no value figure.

limits: Capex is published as a negative outflow (115,948 in parentheses). It is entered here as a positive number, and free cash flow is computed on that basis.

Net income and diluted EPS include net OpenAI-related gains of $5.0 billion and $0.67 per share in FY2026 (MD&A, p.38). FY2025 included losses. The analyst may want to check the figures excluding these items, using the company's own non-GAAP reconciliation (p.44). This sheet uses GAAP figures only.
Total financial debt excludes finance lease liabilities (66,594) and operating lease liabilities (21,925), as the definition requires. Including them would change the net debt figure materially.
Net debt is computed using cash and cash equivalents only (20,935). Short-term investments of 55,908 are excluded as the definition requires.

Page numbers come from the report's index and page markers. Note 10 (Debt) and Note 12 (Unearned Revenue) page numbers were read from page markers in the text and should be checked against the printed document.
